1ae0db4.summary: Saves local work: the finiteVolumeBeam restraint now writes the beam's anchor-end displacement to a history file each step. Bumps the beamFoam submodule to 3deff39 ('Remove old files'), which predates the 6DOF commits.
details: finiteVolumeBeam.C/.H: displacementFilePtr_ writes displacement<name>.dat (W on the anchor patch)
sDoFRGBFvBeam/Make/options: hard-coded /Users/... include path for beamModel

d72ed0a.summary: Passes the body's previous and current state (displacement, orientation, velocity, angular momentum, acceleration, torque) to the beam before each beam solve. Bumps beamFoam to 6c25265.
details: finiteVolumeBeam::restrain fills RigidBodyStepData and calls beam.setRigidBodyStepData
sixDoFRigidBodyMotionFvBeam: new state0() accessor; initialCentreOfRotation() declaration moved
Make/options adds the coupledTotalLagNewtonRaphsonBeam include path

1e5809f.summary: Adds debug printouts of the attachment displacement, beam W values and attachment/anchor forces around the beam evolve call. Bumps beamFoam to a94db8d (the rigidBodyAndBeam tutorial).
details: finiteVolumeBeam.C: 'finiteVolumeBeam debug' Info lines before and after evolve

3dc0bb1.summary: With blockEigenAuthoritativeMotion on, copies the BlockEigen rigid-body result into the motion state and returns zero restraint force and moment. FvBeamNewmark then recomputes velocity, position and orientation after restrain(), so the coupling stays partitioned. Bumps beamFoam to c78419b.
details: New sixDoFRigidBodyMotionFvBeam::applyBlockEigenSolution sets centreOfRotation, v, a, pi, tau and Q
finiteVolumeBeam::restrain takes a non-const motion; sends mass, inertia, centre of rotation and attachment point; reads blockEigenAuthoritativeMotion
sDoFRGBState/Make/options adds BEAMFOAM_DIR include paths; src/beamFoam -> c78419b

ffa51e3.summary: Adds the beamAttachmentKinematics keyword. With solvedByBlockEigen the restraint stops fixing the beam-end W and leaves it to beamFoam's staged mode. Also writes an attachment-force history file. No submodule bump.
details: finiteVolumeBeam: beamAttachmentKinematics_ (prescribedByRigidBody default, or solvedByBlockEigen), stored in the restraint state
